The '''ANx-y sensor package''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] system manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. The package was utilized on [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]<ref name="SWS" /> and [[BTS-A2 Long-Range Strike Fighter/Bomber]].<ref name="H-Wing">{{ChallengeCite|35|The H-Wing Strike Fighter}}</ref>
